description: This source file defines step definitions for Cucumber tests related to scheduling jobs in the Fineract project. It contains methods to execute various scheduled jobs like accrual transactions, business date increase, loan delinquency classification, and others, triggered by Cucumber steps.

classes.name: SchedulerStepDef
classes.description: Defines Cucumber step definitions for executing scheduled jobs within tests.

methods.name: runAccrualTransaction
methods.description: Executes the 'Add Accrual Transactions' job through the job service.

methods.name: runPeriodicAccrualTransaction
methods.description: Executes the 'Add Periodic Accrual Transactions' job.

methods.name: runIncreaseBusinessDate
methods.description: Executes the job to increase the business date by one day.

methods.name: runLoanDelinquencyClassification
methods.description: Runs the loan delinquency classification job.

methods.name: runAddAccrualTransactionsForLoansWithIncomePostedAsTransactions
methods.description: Runs the job to add accrual transactions for loans with posted income as transactions.

methods.name: runCOB
methods.description: Runs the Close Of Business (COB) job.

methods.name: runAccrualActivityPosting
methods.description: Executes the accrual activity posting job.
